name: Washerwoman
summary: Starts knowing that one of two players is a particular Townsfolk.

name: Librarian
summary: Starts knowing that one of two players is a particular Outsider, or that there are none.

name: Investigator
summary: Starts knowing that one of two players is a particular Minion.

name: Chef
summary: Starts knowing how many pairs of evil players sit next to each other.

name: Empath
summary: Learns each night how many of their living neighbours are evil.

name: Fortune Teller
summary: Each night picks two players and learns if either is the Demon, though one good player always reads as the Demon.

name: Undertaker
summary: Each night learns which character was executed that day.

name: Monk
summary: Each night protects another player from the Demon.

name: Ravenkeeper
summary: If killed at night, wakes to learn one player's character.

name: Virgin
summary: The first time they are nominated, a Townsfolk who nominated them is executed on the spot.

name: Slayer
summary: Once per game, publicly picks a player. If it's the Demon, the Demon dies.

name: Soldier
summary: Cannot be killed by the Demon.

name: Mayor
summary: If three players remain and nobody is executed, good wins. Night kills may bounce off them.

name: Butler
summary: Picks a master each night and may only vote when their master votes too.

name: Drunk
summary: Believes they are a Townsfolk, but their ability never works.

name: Recluse
summary: May register as evil, even as a Minion or Demon.

name: Saint
summary: If executed, their team loses.

name: Poisoner
summary: Each night poisons a player, breaking their ability until the next night.

name: Spy
summary: Sees the Grimoire each night and may register as good.

name: Scarlet Woman
summary: If the Demon dies with five or more players alive, becomes the new Demon.

name: Baron
summary: Adds two extra Outsiders to the game.

name: Imp
summary: Kills each night, and can kill themselves to pass the Demon on to a Minion.
